title: Shot Diagram Cloud Restore Fix
notes: Fixes Shot Diagram cloud downloads that reported success but reopened with blank local data.
Persists downloaded Shot Diagram pages, page positions, header information, view state, and sent status to the Shot Diagram's actual local-storage keys before refreshing the inner document.
Saves the active Shot Diagram page into the cloud payload before upload.
Keeps the user inside the Shot Diagram wrapper and shows the loaded cloud revision after the inner diagram refreshes.
Preserves the proven m39.9.2 Drill Log in-place cloud workflow, private Firebase sign-in, revisions, device names, and offline local saving.
